title: forge.CI reads a head whose every check run is SKIPPED as green, and admitted 6in's close-out over a red go job
description:
GitHub.CI starts at CIGreen and treats skipped as neither pass nor fail, so a head carrying only skipped check runs is green. ci.yml skips every pull_request job on epic PRs by design and paths-ignores .ticfac/ on push, so every run-state head of an epic PR is all-skipped: the admission read green at seq 64, two seconds after recording red, and ciForTree never walked back to the code commit (its walk only runs on CINone). An all-skipped (or skipped/neutral-only) set must read as no verdict so the walk finds the code commit's push run; the close gate after the close-out has the same exposure.

ticfac run epic-6in filed this backlog tick from the finding aa8eb9cb2ac6d4b414f179ad28f4024e176efe7be39e5ebc2b0300570a22aca2 (reported by run-epic-6in/tick-v7z/attempt-8): the done is reachable with the finding standing, so it is a backlog tick with an owner rather than the epic's to absorb. The decision record is .ticfac/runs/epic-6in/absorptions/aa8eb9cb2ac6d4b414f179ad28f4024e176efe7be39e5ebc2b0300570a22aca2.json on the run branch.
